description:
FILED s513i (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-10) while running the Text-CSV-2.04 acceptance for the Encode shim (#2946).

LOUD, pre-existing (identical on main e0b61a99): a named sub that reads a file-lexical SCALAR and the same-named file-lexical ARRAY's element refuses the WHOLE file -- "Parser2 TODO: file lexical 'e' captured by sub rf" -- a sigil-blind capture check (MEMORY: "A SIGIL- or SCOPE-blind capture refusal is a BUG -- delete/rename, never narrow").

    my $e = 1;
    my @e = (5, 6);
    sub rf { return $e ? $e[1] : 0 }
    print rf(), "\n";
    perl: 6     PCL: Transpile failed: Parser2 TODO: file lexical 'e' captured by sub rf
    (`sub rf { return $e[1] }` alone works; it is the PAIR $e + $e[...] in one sub.)

VICTIM: Text-CSV-2.04's t/util.pl (`my $ebcdic = ord("A") == 0xc1; my @ebcdic = (...); sub _readable { ... $ebcdic and $cp = $ebcdic[$cp] ... }`), `require`d by 15 of the dist's 38 t/ files -- t/47_comment.t (61 rows) and t/85_util.t (1448 rows) among them, the two `use Encode` files the Encode shim's acceptance needed.  Probes: scratch/s513i/m/r5.pl (worktree agent-abee999f28ae9ef84).
Related: #2014 (the braced-interpolation spelling of the same refusal), #314.


=== DONE (s522a, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19..20) ===
FIXED in commit a821c334 (rebased onto MAIN-READY-37; was 9257085d).  Cause: `_promote_captured` counted a SCALAR canon's "sole hard declaration" over EVERY sigil, so `my $e` beside `my @e` read as two declarations of `e`, `$e` was not promoted, and `_check_sub_captures` refused the whole file.  The rewrites were already sigil-exact (#254 A-iv); the count now is too (`_hard_decl_count` requires the sigil) -- one resolver for detector / rewriter / promoter.
Probes (scratch/s522a/pr/r0, p1-p9: the reproducer, `%e`, two subs, `our @e`, the block-scoped anon-sub pair, assign `$e` + read `$e[0]`, a LATER `my @e`, `$#e`, all three sigils, interpolation) = perl.  `"${e}[1]"` in a sub is a separate pre-existing capture miss, filed #3610.
Bars: guard Pl/t/capture-sigil-01.t (10 rows, 8 fail on aff112d7); gate PASS 324 files / 11,090 rows on the rebased tree 055ebe2e (MAIN-READY-37 + the batch); FULL SWEEP GATE clean TOTAL 18,759 (+0) drops 5 = census; gate-SET scan 638 x 2 IDENTICAL; corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111 (vs aff112d7 and vs 8038fac6); emission-ab lib 55 SAME / 0 DIFF / RCDIFF 0; ir-host-leak 31 = base; ir-conform 328 / 0 / 17 known / 0 stale.
